identity.title: The ALPINE-ALMA [CII] survey. Small Lyα-[CII] velocity offsets in main-sequence galaxies at 4.4 < z < 6

paper_type_evidence.quote: The galaxies for this study have been selected from ALPINE (Le Fèvre et al. 2020; Béthermin et al. 2020; Faisst et al. 2020), an ALMA project with the main goal of revealing [CII]

targets.name: 53 ALPINE main-sequence galaxies with Lyα and [CII] detected (COSMOS and GOODS-S)

evidence.quote: a sample of 118 main-sequence galaxies at $4.4 < z < 6$ in the COSMOS (Scoville et al. 2007) and GOODS-S fields (Giavalisco et al. 2004)
a sample of 118 main-sequence galaxies at $4.4 < z < 6$ in the COSMOS (Scoville et al. 2007) and GOODS-S fields (Giavalisco et al. 2004)

question.value: What are the Lyα-[CII] and ISM-[CII] velocity offsets in main-sequence galaxies at 4.4<z<6, and how do they relate to Lyα escape fraction, EW0 and outflows?

evidence.quote: The goal of this paper is to constrain the properties of the Ly$\alpha$ emission in these galaxies in relation to other properties of the ISM.
This paper is based on data obtained with the ALMA observatory, under the Large Program 2017.1.00428.L.
By combining data obtained with ALMA in band 7 at $\sim$ 320 GHz

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: spectral window tuned on expected [CII] per object; resolution 26-35 km/s

evidence.quote: The final spectral resolution varies with redshift from 26 to 35 km s$^{-1}$
observations of the [CII] 158 $\mu$m line, which enters ALMA bands 6 and 7 at $z>4$
in configurations C43-1 and C43-2, which ideally produce angular resolutions coarser than 0.7 arcsec
the median beam size of the ALMA observations is about 1.13" x 0.85" full width at half maximum (FWHM)
Integration times range between 15 and 30 minutes
starting in May 2018 during cycle 5 and completed in February 2019 in cycle 6

method.value: Lyα peak position vs [CII]; error ~1/5 of line width from simulations; resolution correction of 150 (VUDS) and 50 (CANDELS) km/s

evidence.quote: Therefore we applied an average correction of 150 and 50 km s$^{-1}$ to the offsets between Ly$\alpha$ and [CII] for the VUDS and CANDELS galaxies, respectively.

evidence.quote: we preferred not to correct the individual line profiles for this effect

validation.value: Simulated asymmetric lines; degraded DEIMOS spectra to test peak shift

evidence.quote: we degraded the DEIMOS spectra at the resolution of CANDELS and VUDS, and we measured the shift of the Ly$\alpha$ peak induced by degrading the resolution

analysis_steps.goal: ISM line offsets, EW0 and fesc

method.value: Cross-match Shapley et al. 2003 template (200 perturbations); EW from continuum in 1225-1245 Å windows; fesc from SFR via Kennicutt 1998 with +0.2 dex for 1/5 solar metallicity

evidence.quote: The errors were estimated by repeating the cross-match 200 times, each time perturbing the fluxes according to a Gaussian error distribution

assumptions.value: Case B recombination, Chabrier IMF, one-fifth solar metallicity

evidence.quote: when we assume a metallicity of one-fifth solar (the typical value for main-sequence galaxies found by Faisst et al. 2016 at $z\sim5$)

validation.value: fesc vs EW0 compared with Sobral & Matthee 2019 relation

evidence.quote: 65% of the objects are within $\pm1\sigma$ from it

method.value: Spearman rank test of offsets vs EW0, fesc, M_FUV, mass, SFR, E(B-V)

evidence.quote: We ran a Spearman rank test to check and validate possible correlations between each parameter and the velocity offsets

evidence.quote: with velocity offsets peaking at $\sim$200 km s$^{-1}$ and ranging from -200 to +600 km s$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: Δv_Lyα anticorrelates with EW0 and fesc and correlates positively with E(B-V); no correlation with mass, SFR or M_FUV; no correlation between Δv_ISM and Δv_Lyα

evidence.loc: Correlation of Lyα offsets with other physical properties
evidence.quote: We find that the Ly$\alpha$ velocity offsets are anticorrelated with $EW_0(Ly\alpha)$ and $f_{esc}(Ly\alpha$), but they correlate positively with the E(B-V)$_{\ast}$

claims.hypothesis: Lyα-[CII] offsets at z~5 are smaller than at z~2-3.5
claims.experiment: Measured Lyα peak vs [CII] centroid for 53 galaxies
claims.finding: Offsets are smaller than at lower redshift

evidence.quote: We find that 90% of the selected objects have Ly$\alpha$ -[CII] velocity offsets in the range $0 < \Delta v_{Ly\alpha - [CII]} <$ 400 km s$^{-1}$

claims.experiment: Compared ISM-[CII] offsets with Lyα offsets and escape fraction
claims.result: No correlation between Δv_ISM and Δv_Lyα; most outflows slow
claims.finding: Outflows are not the main driver of Lyα escape at these redshifts; lower NHI or covering fraction favoured

evidence.quote: these results imply that at least at these redshifts, outflows are not the main driver of the escape of Ly$\alpha$ photons.

why_this_method.value: [CII] used as systemic velocity tracer since not absorbed by dust

evidence.quote: [CII] is an optically thin cooling line that is not absorbed by dust and therefore observable in the whole galaxy.

limitations_admitted.value: S/N of spectra insufficient to analyse ISM line morphologies; only centroids

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, the S/N of our spectra is not enough to analyze the details of the ISM line morphologies, and we can only estimate the centroid of the line.
